prompt: Read one nonnegative integer. Tally items that are an odd position; begin the tally at 16. Print the final tally.
reference_source:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER tally=16.
NUMBER hit=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { hit=0. IF (i%2==1) { hit=1. } tally+=hit. }
DISPLAYNL(tally).

prompt: Read four signed integers separated by vertical bars. Tally items that are an entry with square above four; begin the tally at 17. Print the final tally.
reference_source:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER tally=17.
NUMBER hit=0.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { hit=0. IF (values[i]*values[i]>4) { hit=1. } tally+=hit. }
DISPLAYNL(tally).

prompt: Read one nonnegative integer. For each item, independently tally a positive position dividing the input and a position congruent to two modulo three; begin at 7 and print the total.
reference_source:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=7.
NUMBER hitP=0.
NUMBER hitQ=0.
NUMBER i=n.
LOOP (i>=1) { hitP=0. hitQ=0. IF (n%i==0) { hitP=1. } IF (i%3==2) { hitQ=1. } total+=(hitP+hitQ). i-=1. }
DISPLAYNL(total).
